config.py.docstring_purpose: Load and expose all environment-based runtime configuration constants     for LunaWave, including paths, ports, and the admin password.

main.py.docstring_purpose: Bootstrap all LunaWave subsystems and start the async aiohttp web server.

start.py.docstring_purpose: GUI entry point that opens the LunaWave Server Manager desktop window.

adapters/mpv/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: High-level MPV controller combining connection, IPC, and event observation.

adapters/mpv/connection.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the raw socket connection to the MPV media player.

adapters/mpv/ipc.py.docstring_purpose: Handles JSON IPC communication and command execution with MPV.

adapters/mpv/observer.py.docstring_purpose: Observes and dispatches asynchronous events emitted by the MPV player.

adapters/ytdlp/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Unified client for interacting with yt-dlp for search, extraction, and downloading.

adapters/ytdlp/downloader.py.docstring_purpose: Handles downloading audio streams using yt-dlp.

adapters/ytdlp/resolver.py.docstring_purpose: Resolves direct stream URLs for tracks using yt-dlp.

adapters/ytdlp/searcher.py.docstring_purpose: Performs metadata extraction and search operations via yt-dlp.

adapters/ytdlp/ydl_options.py.docstring_purpose: Shared utilities and constants for yt-dlp integration.

automation/architecture_lint.py.docstring_purpose: Validate inter-layer import boundaries against the architecture rules     defined in docs/architecture/dependency_rules.md.

automation/call_graph.py.docstring_purpose: Cari caller & callee dari 1 nama fungsi, scan AST on-demand (bukan     disimpan di repo_index — call-graph lengkap semua-fungsi terlalu besar).

automation/context_pack.py.docstring_purpose: Satu panggilan yang menggabungkan semua tool automation/ jadi 1 JSON —     endpoint utama untuk AI agent supaya tidak perlu 5 panggilan terpisah.

automation/doctor.py.docstring_purpose: Orchestrate all registered health checkers and display a consolidated     project health dashboard with aggregate scores.

automation/event_graph.py.docstring_purpose: Menganalisis dan memvalidasi event pub/sub. Memastikan tidak ada publisher     tanpa subscriber (dead event) dan tidak ada subscriber tanpa publisher (ghost event).

automation/find_owner.py.docstring_purpose: Display ownership, dependencies, and impact radius of a given module,     class, or function name.

automation/generate_file_index.py.docstring_purpose: Generate and inject an auto-produced file index section into     docs/FILE_INDEX.md based on AST analysis of all Python source files.

automation/generate_report.py.docstring_purpose: Generate and inject project statistics into the <!-- BEGIN:GENERATED -->     block of docs/REPORT.md.

automation/hotspot.py.docstring_purpose: Ranking file paling berisiko: skor = churn (jumlah kemunculan di     PATCHLOG.md) x sentralitas (reverse-dep 1-hop dari repo_index).

automation/impact.py.docstring_purpose: Blast radius sebelum refactor/hapus: reverse-dep transitif (import graph)     DIGABUNG reverse-dep via event bus (subscriber dari event yang dipublish     file target) — sisi event wajib, bukan opsional (lihat rationale di atas).

automation/patchlog.py.docstring_purpose: Baca/tulis docs/PATCHLOG.md terstruktur — format v2 (field-based).     ID PATCH-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN, NNN = total entries berjalan (bukan reset per     hari), tetap immutable begitu ditulis.

automation/repo_map.py.docstring_purpose: Hasilkan satu JSON besar berisi peta relasi SELURUH file Python di repo     (layer, import edges, reverse deps, event pub/sub, ukuran) dalam satu     generate — bukan on-demand per simbol seperti find_owner/context_pack.     Ditulis ke docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json supaya AI agent cukup baca 1 file     di awal sesi untuk paham peta relasi lengkap, tanpa panggil tool     berkali-kali satu per satu.

automation/run_all.py.docstring_purpose: Run all documentation generators and the project health check in a     single command.

automation/test_locator.py.docstring_purpose: Petakan source <-> test dua arah via konvensi path-mirroring     tests/unit/<subpath>/test_<nama>.py <-> <subpath>/<nama>.py.

automation/verify_docs.py.docstring_purpose: Orchestrate all documentation health checks and report results as a     human-readable summary or a structured JSON payload.

automation/verify_security.py.docstring_purpose: Verify that sensitive files are listed in .gitignore to prevent     accidental credential or database commits.

automation/verify_structure.py.docstring_purpose: Validate project structure health: oversized Python files and     unimplemented stub items tracked in STATUS.md.

automation/shared/check_result.py.docstring_purpose: Define the CheckResult dataclass and generic weighted-scoring helpers     shared by all LunaWave health checker scripts.

automation/shared/constants.py.docstring_purpose: Konstanta bersama antar checker automation/, misalnya ambang batas     "file besar" yang dipakai automation/verify_structure.py.

automation/shared/generated_block.py.docstring_purpose: Provide replace_marker_block() to update <!-- BEGIN/END:GENERATED -->     sections in Markdown files.

automation/shared/repo_index.py.docstring_purpose: Index AST satu kali untuk seluruh repo (classes, functions, imports, layer,     event publish/subscribe, reverse-deps), dengan cache ber-invalidasi mtime.

automation/shared/skip_dirs.py.docstring_purpose: Define SKIP_DIRS and walk_py_files() used by all scanner scripts to     exclude non-source directories from file system traversal.

automation/verify_docs/checks_coverage.p.docstring_purpose: Implement FILE_INDEX sync, REPORT validation, module docstring coverage,     and overall documentation coverage checks for verify_docs.

automation/verify_docs/checks_docs.py.docstring_purpose: Implement documentation structure, PATCHLOG integrity, frontmatter     validity, and generated-marker pair checks for verify_docs.

automation/verify_docs/checks_files.py.docstring_purpose: Implement large-file and empty-package checks for verify_docs.

automation/verify_docs/doc_parsing_utils.docstring_purpose: Provide shared constants, regex patterns, and I/O/filesystem utilities     for all verify_docs sub-modules.

automation/verify_docs/render.py.docstring_purpose: Render verify_docs check results as a human-readable terminal summary     or a structured JSON report matching the checker contract.

bootstrap/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Startup subsystems for main.py, split out of the former God Function     `main()` (T2.4). Each stage lives in its own module and shares state via     the `BootstrapContext` singleton defined in `bootstrap.services`.

bootstrap/maintenance.py.docstring_purpose: Stage 3 of application startup: schedule the periodic DB maintenance     loop and the MPV connection watchdog as background tasks. Extracted     from main.py's `main()` (T2.4) without changing call order. Also     schedules the ADR-0010 periodic `[STATUS]` summary log.

bootstrap/power.py.docstring_purpose: Acquire a PARTIAL wake-lock via `termux-wake-lock` on startup so the     Android/HyperOS scheduler is less likely to freeze the server process     when the screen turns off. This is a secondary, best-effort layer —     the primary mitigation is the manual OS-level setup documented in     docs/CONSTRAINTS.md (Autostart, battery saver exemption, recent-apps     lock), since custom OEM power policies (HyperOS/MIUI) can ignore the     standard Android wake-lock/notification APIs entirely.

bootstrap/services.py.docstring_purpose: Stage 1 of application startup: open the DB, connect core adapters     (MPV, yt-dlp), and wire every domain service used by the rest of the     app (resolver, playback controller, radio, volume, sleep timer, etc).     Extracted from main.py's `main()` (T2.4, section "1-6" of the original     God Function) without changing call order.

bootstrap/startup_tasks.py.docstring_purpose: Stage 2 of application startup: kick off the background tasks that     must not block the web server from listening — connectivity polling,     the initial MPV connect, and resuming the last-played track. Extracted     from main.py's `main()` (T2.4) without changing call order.

core/command_bus.py.docstring_purpose: Implement a single-writer CommandBus that enforces exactly one handler     per command name and records Prometheus metrics for every execution.

core/commands.py.docstring_purpose: Defines all command constants used by the CommandBus.     Separated to allow importing without pulling in the entire CommandBus.

core/event_bus.py.docstring_purpose: Implement a lightweight async pub/sub EventBus that decouples modules     via typed DomainEvents, using weak references for method handlers.

core/events.py.docstring_purpose: Define all typed DomainEvent dataclasses for the LunaWave event bus.

core/exceptions.py.docstring_purpose: Define the custom exception hierarchy for LunaWave error conditions.

core/latency_window.py.docstring_purpose: Rolling window durasi (detik) untuk menghitung percentile ke-n dari     N sample terakhir. Dipakai untuk threshold adaptif yang bereaksi ke     kondisi jaringan aktual, bukan angka statis.

core/log_categories.py.docstring_purpose: Closed set of `category` constants for structured logging, per the     §4 table in docs/rfc/logging_standard/LOGGING_STANDARD.md (15 rows;     the audit/implementation-plan docs say "14 kategori standar" but the     actual table has 15 -- this module follows the table, the normative     spec, not the prose count). Category groups log lines by *domain of     the event*, never by the Python module/file that emitted them (see     §4 anti-pattern #7).

core/log_config.py.docstring_purpose: Configure structlog and stdlib logging with an async queue handler,     rotating file output, and per-handler rendering (plain file, optional     auto-colored console).

core/log_context.py.docstring_purpose: Thin wrappers over structlog.contextvars for the three correlation     fields defined in docs/rfc/logging_standard/LOGGING_STANDARD.md §5.2:     session_id (one WebSocket connection), request_id (one Command Bus     execution), correlation_id (one flow that crosses separately     scheduled asyncio tasks, e.g. a radio cycle triggering a prefetch, or     a download whose progress hook runs in a separate task).

core/log_reader.py.docstring_purpose: Provide utilities to parse and tail lunawave.log files for dashboard and     observability purposes.

core/mem_stats.py.docstring_purpose: Baca penggunaan RAM (RSS) proses saat ini secara cross-platform tanpa     dependency pip baru (tidak pakai psutil — lihat ADR-0010).

core/observability.py.docstring_purpose: Expose Prometheus metric singletons and an OpenTelemetry tracer for     application-wide instrumentation.

core/ports.py.docstring_purpose: Declare Protocol interfaces (ports) for LunaWave's hexagonal architecture.

core/security.py.docstring_purpose: Provide PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing, constant-time verification,     and SHA-256 session token hashing.

core/server_clock.py.docstring_purpose: Menyimpan waktu mulai server dan menghitung uptime, tanpa dependency     apa pun di luar stdlib.

core/state.py.docstring_purpose: Define shared application state dataclasses, enums, and the single     mutable AppState object for LunaWave.

core/task_utils.py.docstring_purpose: Wrap asyncio.create_task with centralized exception handling to prevent     silent background-task crashes.

data/export_to_sqlite.py.docstring_purpose: Export artist, genre, and song data from a JSON file into a SQLite DB.

engine/command_router.py.docstring_purpose: Register all CMD_* CommandBus handlers, routing each command to the     appropriate method on PlaybackController or VolumeService.

engine/download_manager.py.docstring_purpose: Handle the CMD_DOWNLOAD command by downloading the current or specified     track via yt-dlp and moving it to the downloads/ folder.

engine/queue_manager.py.docstring_purpose: Advance playback to the next track in the user queue when called by     PlaybackController at track end.

engine/sleep_timer.py.docstring_purpose: Handles setting, tracking, and executing a sleep timer to stop playback     after a specified duration.

engine/volume_service.py.docstring_purpose: Handle volume-related commands and apply the correct volume to mpv     based on the active audio output mode.

engine/loudness/analyzer.py.docstring_purpose: Ukur integrated loudness (LUFS) sebuah track via satu-pass ffmpeg     `loudnorm` filter mode measure-only (tidak re-encode, tidak menyimpan file     baru).

engine/loudness/gain_calculator.py.docstring_purpose: Hitung gain (dB) yang perlu diterapkan ke sebuah track supaya loudness-nya     mendekati target, berdasarkan hasil pengukuran integrated loudness (LUFS)     dan true peak (dBTP).

engine/loudness/service.py.docstring_purpose: Orkestrasi analisis loudness: cek apakah track sudah pernah diukur,     kalau belum -> ukur via LoudnessAnalyzer lalu simpan ke DB.

engine/playback/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Re-export PlaybackController as the public interface of the playback     sub-package.

engine/playback/circuit_breaker.py.docstring_purpose: Circuit breaker eksplisit lintas-track untuk PlaybackController --     menggantikan counter integer implisit yang sebelumnya hidup langsung     di controller dengan state machine bernama, tanpa mengubah behavior     lama sedikit pun.

engine/playback/controller.py.docstring_purpose: Orchestrate all playback logic: track loading, queue/radio advancement,     pause/seek, and mode switching via CommandBus commands.

engine/playback/crossfade.py.docstring_purpose: Crossfade helpers untuk transisi halus antar track via MPV volume ramping.

engine/playback/failure_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Menangani semua cabang except dari play_track() saat gagal memutar     sebuah track (video tidak tersedia permanen, bot-check/rate-limit     YouTube, atau error generik lainnya). Diekstrak dari controller.py     (PATCH-2026-07-20-136) agar file controller tetap ramping (di bawah     LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD 500 LOC), sama seperti track_ended_ops.py.

engine/playback/mode_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Handles playback mode switches, such as toggling radio mode or SponsorBlock.

engine/playback/play_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Operations class handling the core logic for playing a track.     Extracted from PlaybackController to maintain a thin orchestrator.

engine/playback/queue_controller.py.docstring_purpose: Menangani command CMD_QUEUE_* (select/remove/add/replace/reorder) dan     advance-to-next (lanjut ke lagu berikutnya, baik mode QUEUE maupun     RADIO). Diekstrak dari PlaybackController (roadmap IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md     §2.3, task T2.3.1) agar controller.py tetap ramping.

engine/playback/queue_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Manages queue operations including adding, removing, and reordering tracks.

engine/playback/settings_controller.py.docstring_purpose: Menangani command CMD_SET_OUTPUT, CMD_SET_SPONSORBLOCK,     CMD_SET_LOUDNESS_NORMALIZATION, CMD_SET_MODE, CMD_RADIO_RANDOMIZE, dan     CMD_LYRICS_OFFSET. Diekstrak dari PlaybackController (roadmap     IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §2.3, task T2.3.2) agar controller.py tetap     ramping.

engine/playback/track_ended_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Menangani reaksi terhadap TrackEndedEvent (eof/stop/error) dan polling     durasi track yang belum diketahui. Diekstrak dari controller.py agar     file controller tetap ramping (di bawah LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD).

engine/playback/track_loader.py.docstring_purpose: Resolve a track URI and trigger background side-effects (sponsorblock,     lyrics fetch, play-count increment) before playback begins.

engine/radio/artist_bandit.py.docstring_purpose: Thompson Sampling (Beta-Bernoulli) untuk memilih artis radio berdasarkan     histori selesai/skip, dengan eksplorasi otomatis untuk artis yang     datanya masih sedikit.

engine/radio/artist_selector.py.docstring_purpose: Selects and rotates artists intelligently to maintain variety in radio mode.

engine/radio/engine.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the state and playback progression for the radio mode feature.

engine/radio/prefetcher.py.docstring_purpose: Pre-fetches tracks asynchronously to ensure seamless transitions in radio mode.

engine/radio/radio_config.py.docstring_purpose: Common utilities and shared logic for the radio engine components.

engine/radio/track_filter.py.docstring_purpose: Filter candidate tracks for the radio queue to prevent duplicates,     skip recently played tracks, and limit artist dominance.

engine/radio/track_interleaver.py.docstring_purpose: Interleaves tracks from different artists to create a balanced radio queue.

launcher/__main__.py.docstring_purpose: Entry point for the LunaWave launcher when executed as a package.

launcher/dep_checker.py.docstring_purpose: Utility to verify required system dependencies before launching the application.

launcher/network.py.docstring_purpose: Provide cross-platform utilities to detect TCP port availability and     identify the PID currently occupying a port.

launcher/preflight.py.docstring_purpose: Unified preflight check for LunaWave to be called by both start.sh and start.bat.

launcher/process.py.docstring_purpose: Manage OS-level lifecycle for the LunaWave server and mpv processes     from the desktop launcher.

launcher/server_lifecycle.py.docstring_purpose: Own the LunaWave server process lifecycle (start/stop/restart, port     conflict resolution, readiness polling, dependency checks) independent     of any GUI toolkit.

launcher/updater.py.docstring_purpose: Stub module reserved for future OTA update checking and release info     retrieval in the LunaWave launcher.

launcher/gui/app.py.docstring_purpose: Provide the Tkinter-based ServerManager GUI for starting, stopping,     and monitoring the LunaWave backend server.

launcher/gui/auth_panel.py.docstring_purpose: GUI hook for the "Reset Password" button. Since T-B16, the launcher no     longer owns any authentication mechanism of its own — it only opens the     web portal, where Initial Setup / Login (SQLite-backed admin_account,     see server/handlers/setup.py) handles credentials end-to-end.

launcher/gui/log_view.py.docstring_purpose: Render log lines and manage clearing of the launcher GUI's log widget.

launcher/gui/popups.py.docstring_purpose: Helper module for displaying generic popup dialogs in the GUI.

launcher/gui/ui_builder.py.docstring_purpose: Constructs the main user interface layout and elements for the launcher.

persistence/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Package entry point for the persistence layer: builds one DB connection     and the six domain repositories that use it. Domain logic itself lives     in each `*_repo.py` module (persistence.track_repo, .session_repo,     .artist_repo, .genre_repo, .library_repo, .discover_repo) — this module     only wires them up.

persistence/admin_account_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the single admin_account row: the sole source of truth for     login credentials under the Fitur B (login_redesign) design. Populated     via the Initial Setup flow (server.handlers.setup), never auto-generated.

persistence/artist_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for tracking artist statistics and fetching artist-specific tracks.

persistence/chat_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository untuk fitur chat (client <-> admin). Menyimpan dan mengambil     pesan chat, disegmentasi per `client_uid` -- BUKAN per `client_ip`.

persistence/db.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the SQLite database connection lifecycle and initialization.

persistence/discover_enrich.py.docstring_purpose: Shared batch-enrichment helper for Discover personalization queries.     Given a list of artist rows, attach a cover thumbnail and genre tag     list to each one using two queries total for the whole batch (never     per-artist), so `discover_repo.py` doesn't run into N+1 query fan-out     when enriching a page of results.

persistence/discover_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for Discover-tab personalization queries: bandit-ranked     "Untuk Kamu" artists, "Belum Pernah Kamu Dengar" (unheard) artists,     genre taste spectrum, genre affinity, and artist detail lookup.

persistence/genre_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for fetching genre information and tracking genre popularity.

persistence/library_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for global library operations such as fetching random songs.

persistence/session_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Manages authentication session tokens, verifying and cleaning up expired sessions.

persistence/stream_cache.py.docstring_purpose: Resolve the playback URI for a track using a priority-based cache     strategy: local file > cached stream URL > fresh yt-dlp extraction.

persistence/track_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for track metadata, play counts, favorites, and local file paths.

plugins/lyrics_fetcher.py.docstring_purpose: Fetch synchronized lyrics from lrclib.net and syncedlyrics, then     update the active lyric index on each playback progress event.

plugins/lyrics_parser.py.docstring_purpose: Parser for extracting timed lyrics from LRC-formatted text.

plugins/lyrics_sync.py.docstring_purpose: Synchronizes lyrics display with current track playback progress.

plugins/notifications.py.docstring_purpose: Mirror current playback state to an Android MediaStyle notification via     termux-notification and relay button presses back via CommandBus.

plugins/sponsorblock.py.docstring_purpose: Fetch SponsorBlock skip segments for the current video and auto-seek     past them during playback.

server/app.py.docstring_purpose: Create and configure the aiohttp web application with all routes,     services, and EventBus listeners wired together.

server/broadcast_service.py.docstring_purpose: Provide typed broadcast helpers that wrap ConnectionManager to push     specific message types to all connected WebSocket clients.

server/connection_manager.py.docstring_purpose: Manages active WebSocket connections and broadcasts events to connected clients.

server/serializers.py.docstring_purpose: Convert between AppState/TrackInfo domain objects and JSON-serializable     dicts for WebSocket message payloads.

server/reset_admin_password.py.docstring_purpose: CLI untuk reset password admin.     Dijalankan via: python -m server.reset_admin_password

server/handlers/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Backward-compatibility re-export of accessor functions from context.py.     New accessors should be added to context.py, not here.

server/handlers/audio_stream_handler.py.docstring_purpose: Proxy cached/streamed MP3 audio for a track, including range-request     support for seeking. Split out of server/handlers/http.py (T3.4) so     the streaming/range-request logic isn't bundled with the SPA/health/     metrics endpoints.

server/handlers/auth.py.docstring_purpose: Handle WebSocket authentication, session token verification, and     per-IP login rate limiting.

server/handlers/context.py.docstring_purpose: Shared, typed accessors for values stashed on `request.app[...]` by     server.app.create_app(). Handlers should use these instead of raw     `request.app[KEY]` lookups so the type of each value is explicit     (T3.7 — dulu rencana ini ditulis untuk `request.app["db"]`, tapi     setelah T2.2 memecah `Database` God Facade, tidak ada lagi key     tunggal "db" — sudah jadi beberapa key spesifik: "repos", "tracks",     "conn", dst. Accessor di bawah menutupi semua key itu).

server/handlers/event_listeners.py.docstring_purpose: Subscribe to domain events from the EventBus and forward them as     WebSocket broadcasts via BroadcastService.

server/handlers/http.py.docstring_purpose: Serve the SPA index, health check, and Prometheus metrics endpoints     over HTTP.

server/handlers/log_dashboard.py.docstring_purpose: Provide HTTP endpoints for the Logging Dashboard (tail, stats, and HTML).

server/handlers/setup.py.docstring_purpose: Handle Initial Setup: creation of the single admin_account row that     becomes the sole source of login credentials (Fitur B: login_redesign,     lihat decisions K3/K4/K5 di task_breakdown_agent.yaml). Runs before any     admin account exists, so it lives outside the normal require_auth gate     -- the same way "auth" itself is special-cased in websocket.py.

server/handlers/websocket.py.docstring_purpose: Handle WebSocket connections, authenticate clients, and dispatch     incoming commands to the CommandBus after rate-limit enforcement.

server/handlers/ws_cache.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for managing the downloaded MP3 file cache     (`DOWNLOAD_DIR`, a.k.a. `cache/mp3/`): reporting its size and clearing it.

server/handlers/ws_chat.py.docstring_purpose: Handler perintah WebSocket untuk fitur chat (client <-> admin).

server/handlers/ws_discovery.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for processing discovery and search commands.

server/handlers/ws_download.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for managing track download requests and status.

server/handlers/ws_log_stream.py.docstring_purpose: Provide WebSocket handler for live log tailing.

server/handlers/ws_playback.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for processing playback control commands.

server/handlers/ws_queue.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for manipulating the current playback queue.

server/handlers/ws_schemas.py.docstring_purpose: Provide strict validation and schema definitions for WebSocket command payloads.

server/middleware/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Package for server-side middleware: per-IP WS command rate limiting     (this file, unchanged) and the aiohttp HTTP traffic middleware added     in ADR-0010 (server.middleware.traffic).

server/middleware/traffic.py.docstring_purpose: Centralized aiohttp middleware for HTTP traffic instrumentation     (ADR-0010 decision OD-3): assign a short correlation id (req_id) per     request, count traffic metrics, and log one summary line per request.

services/discover_ranking.py.docstring_purpose: Pure scoring/aggregation functions for Discover-tab personalization,     split out of persistence.discover_repo.py (T3.3) so the ranking math     is unit-testable with plain numbers instead of a real DB, and so it     lives in the services layer rather than persistence (which is not     allowed to depend on services — see .importlinter).

services/discover_service.py.docstring_purpose: Query the SQLite database to provide discover-page data: recently played     tracks, favorites, cached tracks, and featured artists/genres.

services/stream_prefetch.py.docstring_purpose: Pre-fetch and cache the stream URL for the next track in the background     to reduce playback latency at track transitions.

tests/config.py.docstring_purpose: Load and expose all environment-based runtime configuration constants     for LunaWave, including paths, ports, and the admin password.

tests/fakes/fake_lyrics_provider.py.docstring_purpose: Provides mock lyrics for testing purposes.

tests/fakes/fake_sponsorblock_provider.p.docstring_purpose: Provides mock SponsorBlock segments for testing purposes.

tests/integration/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Integration test package. Tests here use real components     (real SQLite, real aiohttp server, real event bus) but mock     external process dependencies (MPV, yt-dlp) so they run     without hardware dependencies.

tests/integration/conftest.py.docstring_purpose: Shared fixtures for integration tests. Wires up real components     (EventBus, MpvController, Repositories, YtDlpClient, PlaybackController)     but points them to temporary directories and memory databases to     prevent side effects on the dev environment.

tests/integration/test_command_bus_wirin.docstring_purpose: RFC docs/rfc/perbaikan_arsitektur/07_command_bus_dependency_injection.yaml,     task P07-T6: verify that exactly ONE CommandBus instance is alive across     the whole wiring path -- the instance that engine.command_router.CommandRouter     registers handlers on must be IDENTICAL (`is`, not `==`) to the instance     server.handlers.context.get_command_bus(request) returns for a request     against the app produced by server.app.create_app().

tests/integration/test_download_flow.py.docstring_purpose: IT-04: Test end-to-end download communication.     Download -> progress event -> complete event -> file exists.

tests/integration/test_playback_flow.py.docstring_purpose: IT-02: Test end-to-end playback communication.     Play -> pause -> next via CommandBus and verify EventBus.

tests/integration/test_radio_flow.py.docstring_purpose: IT-03: Test end-to-end radio communication.     Radio enabled -> prefetch -> auto-next.

tests/integration/test_websocket_flow.py.docstring_purpose: IT-01: Test end-to-end WebSocket communication.     Connect -> Auth -> Dispatch command -> Receive broadcast state.

tests/unit/test_config.py.docstring_purpose: Unit tests for application configuration and environment variables.

tests/unit/adapters/mpv/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Unit test package for adapters.mpv (MpvIPC, MpvConnection).

tests/unit/adapters/mpv/test_ipc.py.docstring_purpose: Unit tests for MpvIPC — JSON command sending, property get/set,     pending future management. Uses a fake MpvConnection stub instead     of a real socket.

tests/unit/adapters/ytdlp/test_ytdlp.py.docstring_purpose: Unit tests for the adapters.ytdlp package: YtDlpSearcher._to_track and     search filtering logic (tested directly on the split submodules), plus     the YtDlpClient facade end-to-end behavior (search/get_stream_url/     download_audio/cancellation, tested through the facade's public API).     Consolidated from test_ytdlp.py + test_ytdlp_client.py (T4.6) since both     files tested overlapping logic (_to_track, _pick_audio_url) just via     different entry points (submodule directly vs. facade). No assertions     were dropped in the merge — the facade-level classes below are suffixed     "ViaYtDlpClient" to avoid name collision with the submodule-level ones.     yt-dlp is always mocked at the executor level, no real network calls.

tests/unit/automation/test_patchlog.py.docstring_purpose: Regression tests untuk automation/patchlog.py (format v2, field-based,     lihat PATCHLOG_REDESIGN.md dan migrasi v1->v2).
